variants.name: A «Клин»
variants.description: Низкий клиновидный корпус, широкая приплюснутая башня и длинные закрытые борта.
variants.shape: Low broad WEDGE hull with two long continuous track modules, broad shallow flattened hexagonal turret centered on hull, sloped sand turret cheek plates around dark graphite central gun mantlet, one reasonably long slim cannon pointing forward. Mostly sand upper hull plates, large graphite lower side skirts, small pale gray replacement rear deck panel, steel tracks. Clean strong low silhouette, not bulky tank toy.
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE new HUMAN Expedition faction TANK concept for fictional realistic hard-surface RTS game. Reference image 1 use ONLY tank number 5 as old role/family baseline (ignore old roof machine gun and all other units). Reference 2 selected worker B use ONLY approved human faction design language and material palette, do not draw worker or crane. Exactly TWO continuous caterpillar track belts, ONE traversing main turret and ONE conventional single cannon; no roof gun, coax visible gun, missile pod, secondary barrel, drone, shield, stabilizing legs, siege mode, transformation, service arms or humans. Low grounded practical proportions, thin believable layered panels, not giant bloated cartoon tank, not real-world model copy. Single target direct fire tank, no howitzer silhouette. ONE entire vehicle in neutral parked state, turret facing forward, cannon level, elevated FRONT-LEFT 3/4 view suitable for RTS silhouette, full tracks and full muzzle visible with generous margin, warm gray plain studio ground/backdrop, diffuse neutral lighting. Closed hatches, all optics and lights OFF, no firing, glow, smoke, sparks or battle, no text/logos/decals, borders, inset panels, extra objects or people. Faction sand beige matte armor, graphite mechanisms/structural recesses, steel running gear, muted fixed orange accents, possible light gray service panel. Material diversity in broad groups of color/roughness, distinct painted armor vs graphite vs exposed steel, LOCAL subtle edge/contact wear. Do not cover entire vehicle with dry-earth cellular cracks or uniform scratches, no artificial all-over weathering. Reserve readable sand upper side/turret panels for independent future owner-color mask, shown neutral sand now; fixed orange not owner color. New proposals not yet approved, no dimensioned drawings or technical manufacturing plan. Design: Low broad WEDGE hull with two long continuous track modules, broad shallow flattened hexagonal turret centered on hull, sloped sand turret cheek plates around dark graphite central gun mantlet, one reasonably long slim cannon pointing forward. Mostly sand upper hull plates, large graphite lower side skirts, small pale gray replacement rear deck panel, steel tracks. Clean strong low silhouette, not bulky tank toy.

variants.name: B «Низкая башня»
variants.description: Очень низкая башня на графитовой платформе, наклонный нос и частично открытая ходовая.
variants.shape: A very LOW angular turret on visible shallow graphite ring/platform above low chamfered sand hull, two continuous tracks with PARTLY EXPOSED side road wheels beneath thin upper sand guards. Short broad sloping nose. One slim moderately long cannon and no other weapons. Turret central top and mantlet predominantly DARK GRAPHITE, sand angled cheek plates, light gray isolated side service panel, muted orange paint accents. Distinct layered low-profile silhouette.

variants.name: C «Корма»
variants.description: Башня смещена назад, перед ней длинная наклонная бронепалуба; гусеницы прикрыты секционными панелями.
variants.shape: Single low faceted turret set VISIBLY REARWARD on low long hull, creating a long sloping front glacis deck in front of turret. Exactly two continuous tracks partly covered by a few large separate sand side skirt panels, graphite gaps, not extra independent track blocks. One forward-pointing cannon of practical moderate length, no giant siege artillery. Graphite turret shell with sand lower cheek inserts, sand hull, one off-white upper maintenance panel, restrained orange marks. Recognizable balanced rear-turret RTS tank.

variants.name: D «Бронекапсула»
variants.description: Компактная башня-капсула, округло-гранёные углы корпуса и мощные боковые блоки ходовой.
variants.shape: A compact shallow armored turret CAPSULE with rounded-chamfered polygonal corners rather than knife wedge, mounted centrally between two robust but low continuous track modules. Broad short sand hull with beveled front corners and graphite recessed central nose, one cannon from compact dark mantlet. Graphite turret upper surface, light warm gray turret cheek panels, restrained sand hull armor and a few dull orange painted patches, darker side track guards with exposed metal edge wear. Low practical tank silhouette, no domed sci-fi pod or oversized armor.
